Die OXG Glasfaser GmbH ist ein Gemeinschaftsunternehmen von Altice und Vodafone.

Du unterstützt als Werkstudent*in unser Wholesale-Team im operativen Tagesgeschäft rund um Angebotserstellung, Auftragsabwicklung und Faktura.

Du bist immatrikuliert und während der gesamten Dauer Deiner Werkstudierendentätigkeit an einer staatlich anerkannten Universität, (Fach-)Hochschule oder einer vergleichbaren Bildungseinrichtung eingeschrieben.

for everyone
to
have peace of mind in food consumption
. The nature of socializing and work environments is changing, not just for us but for our clients and for society. our team

Experience or great interest in related food laws, food safety, as well as general technical know-how

Experience with quality assurance systems

inputs.job_description:
As our
Working Student: Social Media Content Creator
, you’ll join us at a pretty exciting turning point. We’re currently hitting the "reset" button on our social strategy, and we need someone who doesn't just use TikTok and Instagram, but actually
gets
them.
You won't just be an assistant here; you'll be a key player in helping rebuy find its new voice and making circular living look as cool as it actually is.
In this role, you’ll be doing a bit of everything; from spotting a viral sound before it peaks to being the face of our daily brand stories. One hour you might be filming a "scroll-stopping" video in-house, and the next you’ll be hanging out in the comments, building real connections with our community. It’s a fast-paced, hands-on role where your ideas actually go live instead of just sitting in a slide deck.
If you’re a creative digital native who’s comfortable on camera and wants to use your skills for a mission that actually matters (saving the planet, one device at a time), we’d love for you to help us build this from the ground up!
Ready to become part of the most important mission on this planet? We are rebuy, pioneers in the sustainable reuse of electronics and media and we are looking for you! Our mission: to make circular living accessible to all, one transaction at a time. By giving products a second chance, we reduce resource consumption and avoid unnecessary e-waste.
Our team of 600 comes from all corners of the world; we drive things forward collaboratively, take personal responsibility, value positive critical thinking, and persistently serve our customers and planet.
Key Responsibilities:
Community Engagement:
you’ll be the voice in our comments, hanging out with our followers, answering questions, and building a real connection with our niche communities
Trend Scouting:
You’ll stay ahead of the curve by identifying emerging trends, viral sounds, and niche conversations as they happen. You’ll help us translate what’s bubbling up on the FYP into creative, actionable ideas that keep our brand relevant
In-House Content Creation:
You’ll help concept, film, and edit authentic content for our TikTok and Instagram. You should be comfortable being on camera and have a good eye for what makes a video "scroll-stopping"
Social Organization & Planning:
You’ll keep our content calendar organized, ensuring that posts go live on time and our profiles stay polished and up to date
Creator Support:
You’ll help manage our pool of external creators by organizing their submissions, making sure we have all the assets we need, and keeping our creator lists up to date
Raffles & Specials:
You’ll help organize and execute organic raffles and community giveaways to keep our audience excited and engaged
Requirements:
Currently pursuing a Master’s degree
in Marketing, Communications, Media Studies, or a related field; a Bachelor’s degree is also welcome if you have a strong creative track record
A "Social Media Native"
with a deep personal understanding of TikTok and Instagram; you know the trends, sounds, and formats before they even hit the mainstream
On-camera confidence
is key; you genuinely enjoy presenting, storytelling, and being the face of a digital brand
Technical proficiency in mobile video production
, including hands-on experience with editing tools like CapCut or similar apps to create high-quality Reels and TikToks
Native-level fluency in German
is required for community engagement and copywriting, along with very good
English skills
for our internal team communication
Proactive, trend-oriented, and reliable
, with a "hands-on" mindset and the ability to keep a content calendar organized in a fast-paced environment
Eager to learn and contribute
to a brand "reset," taking ownership of daily community interactions as well as creative content experiments

Work with a friendly team that is passionate about circularity and wants to make the world a little more sustainable, one transaction at a time
Feel comfortable in an environment where independence and new ideas are welcome
Benefit from flat hierarchies and the greatest possible transparency so that things don't take longer than they have to and you always feel well informed
Enjoy our centrally located office in Berlin (Erkelenzdamm 11 - 13, 10999 Berlin)

Bring your dog to the office: we love animals and want to cuddle yours, too!

Have fun at our legendary team and company events
